sources.label: Pokémon GO related patches for apps I use.
sources.author: DanielTheManiel
patch_list: Changes DeFit's app name, header title, and displayed version.
Adds an in-app Google Fit login setup guide and a button to copy the installed APK's signing SHA-1.
Uses Android 12+ wallpaper-derived colors and enables safe system Force Dark without changing DeFit's AppCompat theme parent.
Removes DeFit's bottom banner-ad container from the main layout.
Shows the total distance added during the current sync session in the persistent notification.
Removes the ad requirement and grants the target DeFit version's maximum active time when the button is pressed.
